$viewport.scroll(onViewportScroll);
$(window).resize(function () {
setTimeout(onResize, 10);
});
state.updateViewportDimensions();

if (IS_UNBUNDLED_HORIZONTAL) {
state.scrollable = state.viewportScrollWidth > state.viewportWidth;
} else {
state.scrollable = true;
}
state.showPageIndicator = false;
if (state.scrollable) {
if(state.showPageIndicator){
$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator > .dot").click(onPageIndicatorDotClick);
}


$carousel.addClass("scrollable");
$viewport.scroll();
}
$carousel.css("visibility", "visible");
}

init();
});
</script>

break;
}
var lastRecommendation = recommendations[recommendations.length - 1];
lastRecommendation.parentElement.removeChild(lastRecommendation);
}
}
});
}

<script>
P.when('A', 'jQuery', 'ready').execute(function (A, $) {
const AUTO_SCROLL_TIMEOUT = 4000;
const UNDO_INERTIAL_SCROLL_TIMEOUT = 200;

var $viewport = $carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-viewport");
var $scroller = $carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-scroller");

var state = {
userInputType: null,
scrollTimeout: null,
autoScrollTimeout: null,
pageX: null,
scrollRatio: 0,
viewportScrollWidth: 0,
viewportWidth: 0,

function onResizeAnimation() {

$carousel.toggleClass("scrollable", state.scrollable);

$viewport.scroll();
}


state.animating = false;
}

var activePageNumber = Math.trunc(state.getViewportScrollLeft()) / state.viewportWidth;
if (activePageNumber == 0) {
activePageNumber = 1;
} else if (activePageNumber === Math.ceil(activePageNumber)) {
activePageNumber++;
} else {
activePageNumber = Math.ceil(activePageNumber) + 1;
}

if (!state.isLazyLoadImagesTriggered) {
const $wrapper = $container.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-sub-card-image");
A.loadDescendantImagesManually($wrapper);
state.isLazyLoadImagesTriggered = true;
}


$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator > .active").removeClass("active");
$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator").children().eq(activePageNumber - 1).addClass("active");
state.activePageNumber = activePageNumber;
}

function onUserInputAction(event) {

state.userInputType = event.type === "touchstart" ? "touch" : "mouse";

}

function onViewportScrollAnimation() {

} else if (scrollPct > 99.9) {

scrollToPage(pageNumber);

function scrollToPage(pageNumber){

}, onViewportScroll);

function onPageIndicatorDotClick(event){
event.preventDefault();
let pageNumber = event.target.getAttribute("data-page-number");


scrollToPage(pageNumber);

}

function scrollToPage(pageNumber){
$viewport.animate({
scrollLeft: (pageNumber - 1) * state.getPaginationWidth()
}, onViewportScroll);
}

function autoScroll() {
let scrollLeft = state.getViewportScrollLeft();
scrollLeft = Math.min(scrollLeft + state.getPaginationWidth(), state.getViewportMaxScrollLeft());
$viewport.animate({
scrollLeft: scrollLeft
}, 400, onViewportScroll);
state.autoScrollTimeout = setTimeout(autoScroll, AUTO_SCROLL_TIMEOUT);
}

function copyFirstAndLastPage() {
const $viewPortRowInner = $viewport.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-viewport-row-inner");
const $firstPage = $viewPortRowInner.find("li.sl-sobe-carousel-sub-card").first().clone();
const $lastPage = $viewPortRowInner.find("li.sl-sobe-carousel-sub-card").last().clone();
$firstPage.prop("id", $firstPage.attr("id") + "_clone");
$firstPage.find('a').contents().unwrap();
$lastPage.prop("id", $lastPage.attr("id") + "_clone");
$lastPage.find('a').contents().unwrap();
$viewPortRowInner.prepend($lastPage);
$viewPortRowInner.append($firstPage);
}

function scrollToClosestPage() {
const activePageNumber = Math.round(state.getViewportScrollLeft() / state.viewportWidth);
$viewport.scrollLeft(activePageNumber * state.getPaginationWidth());
}

function init() {
$viewport.bind("mousemove touchstart", onUserInputAction);
$viewport.scroll(onViewportScroll);
$(window).resize(function () {
setTimeout(onResize, 10);
});
state.updateViewportDimensions();

if (IS_UNBUNDLED_HORIZONTAL) {
state.scrollable = state.viewportScrollWidth > state.viewportWidth;
} else {
state.scrollable = false;
}
state.showPageIndicator = false;
if (state.scrollable) {
if(state.showPageIndicator){
$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator > .dot").click(onPageIndicatorDotClick);
}


$carousel.addClass("scrollable");
$viewport.scroll();
}
$carousel.css("visibility", "visible");
}

init();
});
</script>

<script>

const AUTO_SCROLL_TIMEOUT = 4000;
const UNDO_INERTIAL_SCROLL_TIMEOUT = 200;
const IS_UNBUNDLED_HORIZONTAL = "herotator" === "unbundledHorizontalEditorial";
var $container = $("#sobe_d_b_ms_15-container");
var $carousel = $container.find(".sl-sobe-carousel");
var $viewport = $carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-viewport");
var $scroller = $carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-scroller");

var state = {
userInputType: null,
scrollTimeout: null,
autoScrollTimeout: null,
pageX: null,
scrollRatio: 0,
viewportScrollWidth: 0,
viewportWidth: 0,
isLazyLoadImagesTriggered: false,
getViewportScrollLeft: function () {
return this.scrollRatio * this.getViewportMaxScrollLeft();
},
getViewportMaxScrollLeft: function () {
return this.viewportScrollWidth - this.viewportWidth;
},
getScrollerWidth: function () {
return this.viewportWidth / 5.0;
},
getPaginationWidth: function() {
var fullyVisibleSubCardsWidth = this.viewportWidth * 1.0 * 1;
var visibleMarginsWidth = this.viewportWidth * 0.0 * 0;
return fullyVisibleSubCardsWidth + visibleMarginsWidth;
},
updateViewportDimensions: function () {
var rect = $viewport[0].getBoundingClientRect();
state.viewportWidth = rect.width;
state.viewportScrollWidth = $viewport[0].scrollWidth;
}
};

function onResize() {
if (state.animating) {
return;
}
state.animating = true;
requestAnimationFrame(onResizeAnimation);
}

function onResizeAnimation() {
state.updateViewportDimensions();

if (IS_UNBUNDLED_HORIZONTAL) {

}
}

}

state.animating = false;

function updatePageIndicator() {

if (activePageNumber == 0) {
activePageNumber = 1;
} else if (activePageNumber === Math.ceil(activePageNumber)) {
activePageNumber++;
} else {
activePageNumber = Math.ceil(activePageNumber) + 1;
}

if (!state.isLazyLoadImagesTriggered) {
const $wrapper = $container.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-sub-card-image");
A.loadDescendantImagesManually($wrapper);
state.isLazyLoadImagesTriggered = true;
}

activePageNumber--;

$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator > .active").removeClass("active");
$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator").children().eq(activePageNumber - 1).addClass("active");
if (activePageNumber > 5.0) {
$carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-page-indicator").children().eq(0).addClass("active");
}
state.activePageNumber = activePageNumber;
}

function onUserInputAction(event) {
if (state.userInputType != null) { return; }
state.userInputType = event.type === "touchstart" ? "touch" : "mouse";
if (state.userInputType === "mouse" && state.scrollable) {
var $nav = $carousel.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-nav");

$nav.find(".sl-sobe-carousel-goto-nextpage").click({type: "next"}, onNavButtonClick);

}
if (state.userInputType === "touch" && state.scrollable) {

let touchStartY;

.bind("touchend touchcancel", function (event) {

let touchEndY = touch.pageY;

if (Math.abs(touchStartX - touchEndX) / Math.abs(touchStartY - touchEndY) > swipeScrollDirectionThreshold) {

} else {
scrollLeft = Math.min((startPage + 1) * state.getPaginationWidth(), state.getViewportMaxScrollLeft());
}
} else {
scrollLeft = startPage * state.getPaginationWidth();

state.autoScrollTimeout = setTimeout(autoScroll, AUTO_SCROLL_TIMEOUT);

state.autoScrollTimeout = setTimeout(autoScroll, AUTO_SCROLL_TIMEOUT);

copyFirstAndLastPage();
state.updateViewportDimensions();
$viewport.scrollLeft(1 * state.getPaginationWidth());

$carousel.addClass("scrollable");
$viewport.scroll();

}

// We calculate Relative luminance https://www.w3.org/WAI/GL/wiki/Relative_luminance
// If no good match we return 255 as thats value for white and nothing happens
function lightness(rgb){
if(rgb == null){
return 255;
}
const colors = rgb.match(/^rgb\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)\)$/);
if(Array.isArray(colors) && colors.length === 4){
const r = colors[1];
const g = colors[2];
const b = colors[3];
return (0.2126*r + 0.7152*g+ 0.0722*b);
}
return 255;
}

let lightnessOfBgColor = lightness(rgb);
if (lightnessOfBgColor < 220){

}
});

Premium fabrics and thoughtful tailoring enhance the overall look and feel, making your outfits suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions.</span></p><p><span>• Comfort and Breathability: Materials like cotton blends and breathable fabrics keep you comfortable all day long.</span></p><p><span>• Timeless Style: Classic mens wear pieces never go out of fashion and can be paired with trendier items for a balanced look.</span></p><p><span>• Versatility: From </span><a class="a-link-normal" href="/b/?_encoding=UTF8&amp;ie=UTF8&amp;node=1968120031&amp;ref_=cct_cg_LAWMSEO_1a1&amp;pf_rd_p=4a2a0fce-e076-45be-8800-df4006911309&amp;pf_rd_r=4Z2Z3VBZ2BH78ZF8C9G4"><span>t-shirts for men</span></a><span> to formal mens casual shirts, quality apparel can transition seamlessly from work to weekend.</span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>Popular Styles in Men&#x27;s Clothing</span></span></p><p><span>Mens clothing offers a wide range of styles catering to different tastes and needs:</span></p><p><span>• T-Shirts for Men: Essential for any wardrobe, available in various fits and colors, perfect for casual and semi-casual looks.</span></p><p><span>• Mens Casual Shirts: Ideal for both office and relaxed settings, these shirts offer comfort with style.</span></p><p><span>• Formal Mens Wear: Suits, blazers, and dress shirts tailored for professional and formal occasions.</span></p><p><span>• Mens Apparel for Layering: Jackets, hoodies, and cardigans that complement your outfit in cooler weather.</span></p><p><span>• Ethnic and Traditional Wear: Perfect for cultural events and celebrations, blending heritage with contemporary design.</span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>How to Choose the Right Men&#x27;s Clothing</span></span></p><p><span>Selecting the perfect mens clothing depends on your lifestyle, occasion, and comfort preferences:</span></p><p><span>• Consider the Fabric: Opt for breathable cotton or blends for casual wear; choose finer fabrics like linen or wool for formal </span><a class="a-link-normal" href="/b/?_encoding=UTF8&amp;ie=UTF8&amp;node=203923652031&amp;ref_=cct_cg_LAWMSEO_1a1&amp;pf_rd_p=4a2a0fce-e076-45be-8800-df4006911309&amp;pf_rd_r=4Z2Z3VBZ2BH78ZF8C9G4"><span>mens wear</span></a><span>.</span></p><p><span>• Match to Occasion: T-shirts for men are great for casual days, while mens casual shirts and formal wear suit work and special events.</span></p><p><span>• Pick the Right Fit: Ensure your clothing fits well—neither too tight nor too loose—for a polished appearance.</span></p><p><span>• Color Coordination: Choose colors that complement your skin tone and fit the occasion, from vibrant hues for casual outings to muted tones for formal events.</span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>Styling Tips for Men&#x27;s Clothing</span></span></p><p><span>• Pair t-shirts for men with denim or chinos for a casual, effortless look.</span></p><p><span>• Combine </span><a class="a-link-normal" href="/b/?_encoding=UTF8&amp;ie=UTF8&amp;node=21495698031&amp;ref_=cct_cg_LAWMSEO_1a1&amp;pf_rd_p=4a2a0fce-e076-45be-8800-df4006911309&amp;pf_rd_r=4Z2Z3VBZ2BH78ZF8C9G4"><span>mens casual shirts</span></a><span> with tailored trousers for smart-casual occasions.</span></p><p><span>• Layer </span><a class="a-link-normal" href="/b/?_encoding=UTF8&amp;ie=UTF8&amp;node=17522261031&amp;ref_=cct_cg_LAWMSEO_1a1&amp;pf_rd_p=4a2a0fce-e076-45be-8800-df4006911309&amp;pf_rd_r=4Z2Z3VBZ2BH78ZF8C9G4"><span>mens apparel</span></a><span> like jackets over basic tees for a stylish, functional outfit.</span></p><p><span>• Use accessories like watches or belts to enhance your overall mens wear ensemble.</span></p><p><span>• Choose versatile pieces that mix and match easily to maximize your wardrobe options.</span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>FAQs on Men&#x27;s Clothing</span></span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>What are the must-have men&#x27;s clothing items for every wardrobe?</span></span></p><p><span>The list should include good quality t-shirts for men, great casual shirts, well-fitting jeans or chinos, a formal piece and jackets or hoodies. </span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>Where can I buy reliable men&#x27;s clothing online?</span></span><span> You can find a wide variety of mens clothing online on trusted platforms like Amazon India, offering everything from casual wear to formal mens wear. </span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>How do I choose the right fit for men&#x27;s casual shirts?</span></span></p><p><span>Look for shirts that allow comfortable movement without excess fabric. Slim fit suits those who prefer a modern look, while regular fit offers more room for ease and comfort.</span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>Can t-shirts for men be worn in formal settings?</span></span></p><p><span>Generally, t-shirts are casual wear, but pairing a high-quality, plain t-shirt with a blazer can create a smart-casual look suitable for some informal business environments. </span></p><p><span class="a-text-bold"><span>How to care for men&#x27;s apparel to ensure longevity?</span></span></p><p><span>Follow fabric-specific care instructions, wash clothes in cold water to preserve color, avoid over-drying, and iron as needed to maintain a crisp appearance.</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><script>if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="content-grid-card_apb-browse_50"]', '#CardInstance8AA30RoO88kp5ftq4Um-Ug')('mark', 'be')}</script>
